description: M12A weapon SFX prompt registry — per-weapon-class × per-action prompt strings for Stable Audio Open / AudioCraft synthesis. Each entry has prompt + duration_target + format + tag mapping (manifest.json cue tag). M37 will replace with full library; M12A initial bake uses these prompts. Output target: 16-bit PCM WAV @ 48kHz / mono / -12 dBFS peak / -18 LUFS integrated.
